protocol.state_loss: exact Phase0 latent_loss with frozen native reconstruction
protocol.selection: validation mean question-macro oracle K-gap of R-nonzero and E-full-prefix
protocol.selection_C: same validation cohorts, Qwen child-K MAE (no oracle-fitting target)
protocol.fidelity_reference: minimum validation state loss over all converged-budget A checkpoints, per seed
protocol.no_eligible_pilot: report unsupported; do not silently relax the fidelity gate
protocol.test_open: after lambda lock and all final training selections
protocol.delta_truth_anchor: true parent K is loss/evaluation metadata only; anchored delta-MAE equals child-K MAE
protocol.verdict_scope: exploratory on reused GSM8K questions; fixed budget is not proof of convergence
